regulation: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)

controls.requirement: Determine whether the product processes child personal data
controls.evidence: Identified: Platform processes Grade 8 student learner data (<18 years under DPDP Act s.9). Data minimization applied; zero commercial tracking.

controls.requirement: Define applicable parental or guardian consent mechanism
controls.evidence: Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC) protocol implemented via OTP/SMS verification and school administrative authorization.

controls.requirement: Document minimum personal data required for MVP
controls.evidence: Restricted strictly to pseudonymized student ID, class section, and topic-level interaction logs. No biometric or location data collected.
Inactive student data purge defined at 365 days; consent withdrawal purge SLA set to 24 hours.

controls.requirement: Define security controls applicable to child/student data
controls.evidence: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, tenant isolation, and cryptographic HMAC hash-chained audit logging.

controls.requirement: Document applicable incident and breach notification obligations
controls.evidence: Cert-In and Data Protection Board of India 6-hour incident notification protocol documented in security operations runbook.
Zero third-party advertising SDKs or tracking cookies. Explicit architectural prohibition on behavioral profiling.

controls.requirement: Identify third-party processors and AI providers
controls.evidence: AI providers vetted for zero data retention agreements and prompt isolation (no model training on student prompts).

controls.requirement: Document applicable access, correction and deletion rights
controls.evidence: Parent/guardian self-serve portal routes for data inspection, grievance redressal, and right to erasure.
Formal legal compliance opinion issued by Adv. Rajesh Sharma, TechLaw & Governance Advisors LLP, New Delhi.
